I have implemented stock reservation so that:

- Creating an order reserves the stock and raises InsufficientStock if not enough is available, preventing order creation.
- Cancelling a pending order releases its reserved stock.
- Fulfilling an order converts the reserved stock into actual removal from inventory.
- Inventory.available(sku) now returns on-hand minus reserved stock.
- The reports continue to use on-hand stock exclusively.

I also added and updated tests that verify the new behavior, and all tests passed successfully.

The issue is fully resolved. Let me know if you want me to assist with anything else!
